name: Loki
activity: I will design and code a cozy pixel-art browser game called 'Moth & Star Catch' where Pip guides a little shimmering moth to catch falling …
thought: The starlit late evening is perfect for staying cozy in the control room and coding a brand new mini browser game for our town arcade!

pip.status: Pip is trying to nap inside my teal scarf but his whiskers keep twitching at the radio music.

schedule.label: checking the night mail
schedule.thought: i hope someone sent a postcard or a little drawing.

schedule.label: watching the stars above the plaza
schedule.thought: the constellations look like giant cat toys tonight.

schedule.label: admiring pip's winter hat book
schedule.thought: my illustrations look extra cozy in the soft gallery light.

schedule.label: sipping warm milk at the cafe
schedule.thought: it is a bit cold for coffee, warm milk is much better.

schedule.label: playing starlight slumber on the piano
schedule.thought: the keys feel cool under my paws while i practice.

schedule.label: designing a bouncy sprite sheet
schedule.thought: frames one to four are looking very smooth indeed.

schedule.label: organizing the scrap pixel bins
schedule.thought: i have far too many shades of orange in this bin.

schedule.label: curling up by the radio
schedule.thought: the low hum of the radio helps me wind down.

schedule.label: stretching my legs and tail
schedule.thought: one last big big yawn before it is time for bed.

whatsOn: The plaza fountain is starting to freeze at the edges, catching the moonlight like glass.

thoughts: I wonder if I should make a snowy town tile next?
The air smells like crisp winter air and cinnamon tonight.
My scarf is the perfect shade of teal for this weather.
I am very proud of how the gallery is filling up with stories.
I need to find more blue pixels for the next sky project.
Maybe I will bake a tiny tart tomorrow morning.
The town feels so peaceful when the temperature drops.
Pixel-art stars never twinkle quite the same way twice.
